notes.title: Seed Hunter Update: English & Japanese Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/3e1ec3087c57420b774d3846cb469c21226f815e.jpg

Hunters,

After long time waiting, we finally finished the English and Japanese localization and we’re glad to bring it to you today! If this is what keep you waiting for a long time, now it is time to play!

Thanks you for your longtime supporting to us, hunters! We are pretty sure you want to see more in our game. And yes, we will and we can do this in the future updates!

May our hunting begin,
Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: Roadmap: Achievement System, Bug Fix, Multi-Languages Support
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

Thanks for playing Seed Hunter!
We already receive a lot of suggestions about how to make our game better. And we know we must going on to make this game better!

So in our roadmap, We will have following updates bring right to you:
- Achievement System, We already put our mind into it. In the next update, you can get it!
- Bug fix(We will fix bugs we already know)
- Multi-Languages Support. We are working on our English and Japanese version!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/77eee589c241556aca6b065a65c1c0451def52f4.gif

If you meet any bugs or have any trouble, please share with us!
We will make our best to bring you the best game we can ever make.

Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: The Guardian Of the mausoleum, Seed Hunter v.0.2.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hunters,

Source makes everyone crazy, but some people can use it.
And Some craftsman even makes hurndreds of robots powered by the crazy source.

The Ancient Guardian is one of them, craftsman of the mausoleum build this for their work.
When their job done, this robot become the true killing machine, protect this poor grave forever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069330/faf24819b3995f22605743eac6870ce12e409f09.gif

At the latest v.0.2.4, You will meet this killing machine.
For the passing lives, Hunters, destroy it!

================

Seed Hunter

Release Notes

v. 0.2.4

================

1. New Boss: Ancient Guardian 
2. UX: Add Bossbar
3. UX: No more limit for the bag

May our hunting begin again,
Seed Hunter Team

notes.title: Sorry! Release Date Has Been Delay!
notes.notes:
We are sorry for delaying our game which planed to be released on July 11th. 

While it might be a sorrow thing for our game fans, but I believe that this can only leading our game to be a greater one for having much more stable game experience and adding more content for you enjoying our game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35069330/84931f94ce40aaac0a7d21d34ea57b51c23bc6a3.gif

So here we are announcing the released date for Seed hunter, which has been decided on July 18th! 

Thanks for everyone following our game for such a long time! Wishing all of you have a good hunt for finding seed!

Cheers,
Seed Hunter Team
